historical_notes: Development build with the local Rust admission patch, before the proxy handshake fix and HTTP cache connection/restore changes. The measured proxy did not enforce its extra new-connection delay. Network results do not describe the current implementation; cold builds use no shared cache and are unaffected by that proxy issue.
